model.name: currentSprint.autoProgressPin
model.description: The CurrentSprint pin AUTO-PROGRESSES on a QA-Review transition, BY DERIVATION (not a stored write): on QA-Review the current slot advances + a new next is derived by sprint-completion; explicit-R40.17-designation WINS while still valid; lastCompleted follows DONE (not QA); unresolved -> fail-loud; the derivation reads the STATUS ENUM, never a symbol. ONE unified behavior (the 8 BITEs are its facets, not separate use cases). Reuses slotsFrom (no new machinery); observable stale-steer is logged (not a pin-write).
